text.p: Morocco's bourse closed on Tuesday almost unchanged with half the stocks traded making modest gains and the others falling slightly, brokers said.
The all-share index closed at 665.91 points from 665.93 points on Monday.

Morocco's largest private conglomerate, ONA Group edged up two dirhams to 834 with 3,747 shares exchanged while the second holding Societe Nationale d'Investissement dipped six dirhams to 790 dirhams.

In the banking sector, the market's second biggest capitalisation Banque Commerciale du Maroc dropped four dirhams to 905. Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, was up 14 dirhams to 585 dirhams. Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce et l'Industrie, shed two to 483 dirhams.
Wafabank fell four dirhams to 866 dirhams.
In the energy sector, oil refinery Samir shed one dirham to 338, Sonasid gained two dirhams to 569 dirhams.
Casablanca Finance Intermediation (CFI) said on Tuesday that revenue from Sonasid was expected to rise to 1.82 billion dirhams ($186 million) this year, 2.1 percent up from last year.

On the official market, total traded volume was 30 million dirhams from 21 million dirhams. On the over-the-counter market trade totalled 33 million dirhams from 10.2 million dirhams. Main trade on this market was in 3,850 shares of cement firm Lafarge Ciments, a broker said.
